pr.title: Show retrying deliveries on the endpoint page
pr.author: example-dev
pr.head: endpoint-retrying

overview.summary: #42 added a retrying state, but the endpoint page still counted deliveries as pending, delivered or failed, so a delivery waiting for its next post was invisible. This pull request counts each of the four states and shows when the soonest retry is due.
steps: `deliveryCounts` counts the four states and finds the soonest retry.
The docs describe the endpoint page's counts.

diagram.title: The endpoint page asks for its delivery counts
diagram.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  P[endpoint page] --> C["deliveryCounts(db, endpointId)"]:::new
  C -->|"one per state, in parallel"| N["db.deliveries.count(where)"]:::new
  C -->|"limit 1, by nextAttemptAt"| F["the soonest retrying delivery"]:::new
  C --> R["four counts and nextRetryAt"]:::new

chapters.title: Counts for every delivery state
body: [`deliveryCounts`](ref:src/api/endpoint.ts:15) asks the store for one count per state, in parallel, and reads the single retrying delivery with the smallest `nextAttemptAt` to say when the next post is due.
`Db` gains `count`, which takes the same filter as `find`. With no retrying delivery, `nextRetryAt` is `null`.

cells: its own count, with the next post's time

chapters.title: Tests for the counts
chapters.body: One test counts a mix of states and checks that the soonest retry wins; another checks that `nextRetryAt` is `null` with nothing retrying.
